conventions.fn: VaultHarness.checkpoint(Obs o, bool liveOk, int24 liveTick): the vault's _checkpoint(o) with no PoolManager; the harness sets the state of in.state through its setters, stubs ackBreaches (recorded as an emitted {ackBreaches: {n}}) and overrides _tryRef() to return (liveOk, liveTick) and count its calls.
conventions.events: in.events[i] = {block, ts, obs, live}: vm.roll(block), vm.warp(ts), then checkpoint(obs, live != "fail", live == "fail" ? 0 : live). The state carries over between events.
conventions.state: {holdings {idle0, idle1, L, lo, hi} (lo/hi = the registered range; EMPTY = 0/0), bank (as bank.json), NAV0, delta0 (WAD), tauV0, segStart, S, baseOwed, epoch, epochSwapFrac, swapCount, records}; in.state.records is empty.
conventions.out: out.steps[i] = {state after event i, liveReads (the _tryRef calls during the event: 0 or 1; the gate's live leg is read only when vestable, and a mint at a stale cache reads tryRef), emitted}. emitted pins the vault events Checkpoint(tauV, tauB, nav0, delta, base, L, lo, hi), BreachProcessed(count, lastBlock, forfeited), CheckpointDeferred(), ModeChanged(from, to) and EpochRecorded(e) plus the ackBreaches stub, in order.
conventions.records: records[e] = every EpochRecord field (spec §3.9; end = 0 and tauV/tauB the counters at start while the record is open; a record the scenario did not open has start 0); the scenarios run checkpoints only, so charge, bankBurned and bondBurned are 0 here (the action and settlement rows pin them). Every epoch from in.state.epoch to the last step's epoch + 1 that the model did not write is empty. flags are names; as a u8 the bit of each flag is its position in the record's flag list (0 stale, 1 witnessMissing, 2 witnessFallback, 3 breach, 4 refStale, 5 deferred, 6 unverified).

notes.scenario-001-gate-live-out: cache fresh and in range, live reference out: no vest, matured cohort to maturedPending
notes.scenario-003-gate-live-fail-tick0-inside: a failed read whose tick field is 0 inside the range must not open the gate
notes.scenario-009-only-maturedPending-reads: only maturedPending matured: the live leg is read and an out-of-range live reference blocks the vest
